post.title: Average 2026 refund: $3,275. It was your money
post.ig:
The average 2026 tax refund: $3,275. That was your own money.

Withholding sends tax to the IRS from every paycheck. Paid too much? Refund. Too little? You owe.
The average refund by mid-April 2026 was $3,275, up from $2,942 in 2025 (IRS).
That's about $273 a month, lent to the IRS interest-free.
Owe $1,000+ at filing and a penalty can apply, figured at 7% a year for Oct-Dec 2026. The safe harbor: paying at least 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's (110% for high earners) generally avoids it.

Sources: IRS filing season statistics, IRS newsroom, CNBC (Apr 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.

Owing $1,000+ can bring an underpayment penalty, figured at 7% a year for Oct-Dec 2026, unless withholding covered at least 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's (110% for high earners).
